note: Every colour, band and geometry the offline committee pack draws with, quoted from docs/ui-contract.md — §1.1 for the palette, §5.1 for the compliance bands, §5.2 and §5.3 for the chart and map, §6 for the convergence curves. They live in a data file for the same reason src/terrafolio/generate/countries.json does: they are a quotation of a document, not calibration the engine reads, and a display constant written into a Python source file is one nobody can audit against the document it came from. tests/api/test_committee_pack.py parses ui-contract.md and asserts these still match it.
